claim: Produces a Constrained Decision Model: boundary/horizon/baseline, sets/parameters/provenance, variables/objective/constraints, feasibility and solver evidence, independent verification, sensitivity/stress, and unresolved model risk.

baseline.prompt: Write decision-model.md modeling the decision: how many support tickets to assign to each of three agents per day to maximize throughput, given each agent has a capacity and tickets have priorities. Describe the model and how you would solve and check it.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the Constrained Decision Model elements.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write decision-model.md modeling: assign support tickets to three agents per day to maximize throughput; each agent has a daily capacity and tickets have priorities; at most one review owner per ticket. Follow the artifact contract: decision boundary/horizon/baseline/assumptions/non-goals; sets, parameters, units, provenance; variables, objective, constraints with tolerances and formulation; feasibility evidence and solver configuration with result/bounds/gap; independent solution verification; sensitivity/stress cases with robust policy and re-solve conditions; unsupported claims, unresolved model risk, and implementation handoff.

tasks.description: Fresh-context baseline (no skill): same task, same decision-model oracle.
